paper.title_en: 10D Supergravity Numerical Data Sets for L & R Matrices
paper.abstract_en: After reviewing the development of 10D, superspace theories, and their relations to superstring and heterotic string theories, explicit calculations are undertaken in the on-shell $\cal N$ = 1 linearized supergravity, the associated super-current is derived, and non-closure terms are explicitly given. The $L_{\rm I}$ and $R_{\rm I}$ adjacency matrices are then computed in complete numerical form as data sets. This is the preliminary step required to perform a scan to embed the on-shell matrices into off-shell ones.
